I posted the draft bullets for the note to June as a reply in #coastal-team. They cover the 16 Feb rename from Covey & Lark to Pellow Home Living, and Moss's digest saying a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". The rename date and the digest wording come from your message; I didn't open the digest to check them.

The last two bullets are mine, not yours. One says people may not realise "Covey" and PHL are the same account. The other lists what's still to confirm: which report it is, who owns it, and whether it should be renamed. Cut or change either if they don't fit.

If you tell me what to add, I can turn the bullets into a mail draft to June.
